design: models held fixed; evaluation population advances through launch-year slices. This is evaluation-population sensitivity, NOT rolling-origin retraining
exploratory_note: the parent test folds have been scored repeatedly; this is a robustness re-analysis and not independent confirmation
promotion_criteria: significantly better (BH-corrected) in a majority of eligible slices
coverage not degraded relative to the incumbent
not_established: models were not refitted per slice, so this does not test selection under rolling-origin retraining
slices are sub-populations of already-scored test folds
slice sample sizes (150-843 objects) limit power within each slice
